title: DevOps Engineer - Security and Compliance
description:
DevOps Engineer, Security and Compliance
 About Kantiv
 Kantiv (previously Joist AI) provides a pursuit intelligence solution designed for the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction sector. AEC organizations rely heavily on proposal workflows: marketing groups dedicate immense effort to locating assets, gathering technical details from busy engineering staff, and recreating organizational expertise for each new bid. Kantiv streamlines this process by centralizing historical project data, staff qualifications, and client records into a unified platform that improves with every completed bid, enabling proposal managers to focus on strategy rather than repetitive tasks.
 Our team brings direct experience from AEC marketing operations, giving us a clear view of the operational inefficiencies inherent in traditional proposal management. This background directly informs our system architecture, product direction, and go-to-market execution.
 Established in 2022 as Joist AI, the company transitioned to the Kantiv brand in June 2026. We are currently scaling operations with proven product-market fit, supporting prominent ENR 500 enterprise clients, and actively driving expansion across the sector over the next 18 months.
 
 Role 
 You'll run ourAWS infrastructure with a security and compliance lens. You'll make sure every control we claim in an audit is built into the platform, monitored and backed by evidence.
 You'll join a DevOps and security team of four and report to our Senior DevOps Engineer. You'll work closely with our security engineer, the product engineering leads and the people who run our audits.
 Responsibilities
 Design and build isolated, compliance-readyAWS environments for customers with stricter regulatory requirements.
 Implement and maintain security controls: encryption, key management and rotation, data residency and tenant isolation.
 Review third-party services against our security and compliance requirements. Run and automate our SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC and GDPR controls, and keep audit evidence current in our compliance platform.
 Manage access to production: least privilege, just-in-time access, regular access reviews and clean offboarding.
 Manage infrastructure as code in Terraform, with policy checks in CI. Run quarterly disaster recovery tests and fix what they find.
 Answer the technical parts of customer security questionnaires.
 Must-haves
 3 or more years in DevOps, cloud infrastructure or site reliability, with at least 2 years running production on AWS.
 Hands-on work on at least one formal compliance program, such as FedRAMP, CMMC, SOC 2 or ISO 27001. You built controls and handed evidence to auditors, not just filled in questionnaires.
 Strong AWS security: IAM, KMS, VPC design, CloudTrail, GuardDuty and Security Hub. Terraform for real production infrastructure.
 Comfort with encryption in practice: TLS everywhere, encryption at rest and key rotation.
 You write clearly. Your runbooks, design notes and control descriptions can be handed to an auditor as they are.
 Securing CI/CD: GitHub Actions or similar, with short-lived credentials and least privilege deploy roles.
 Serverless and container workloads in production: Lambda, ECS or similar, including image scanning and patching.
 Scripting in Python or a similar language to automate checks and evidence.
 Nice to have
 You've worked in AWS GovCloud orAzure Government.
 You've taken part in a FedRAMP authorization or a CMMC Level 2 assessment. You've used compliance automation tools such as Drata or Vanta.
 You've run AI or LLM workloads in production, for example on Amazon Bedrock. You've worked with multi-tenant data isolation.
 You hold a security certification such as AWS Security Specialty, CISSP or CCSP. You've worked with FIPS-validated cryptographic modules.
 First 90 days
 1. By day 30: you know ourAWS setup, Terraform and audit calendar. You've also reviewed our third-party services and security tooling.
 2. By day 60: you've agreed your first infrastructure design with the team and shipped your first control improvements.
 3. By day 90: your first major project is in production, you've run a disaster recovery test, and evidence for the next SOC 2 and ISO audits is up to date.
 Benefits & Perks 
 
 Health Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance coverage.


 Unlimited PTO: Flexible, unlimited paid time off to support work-life balance.


 Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with a distributed, collaborative team.


 Ownership & Impact: Opportunity to take ownership of critical infrastructure and security initiatives in a growing AI startup.


 Learning & Growth: Exposure to advanced cloud infrastructure, security frameworks and compliance programs.
